description: Department of Fiscal Policy - The Finance Act, No. 25 of 2003, Order under Section 2(1) (Amended Gaz. Ex. 2342/24, dated 25.07.2023 and 2329/19 dated 25.04.2023 Substitution with effect from 01.02.2024
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an order amending schedules under the Finance Act, No. 25 of 2003, which constitutes a regulatory matter. It involves the modification of existing legal provisions (specifically airport departure fees) through statutory authority, making it a legal/regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
